items.title: 'Top, top bowler': Kent's Milnes full of praise for Hasan Mahmud
items.summary: Kent seamer Matt Milnes was full of praise for his bowling partner Hasan Mahmud after the Bangladesh pacer continued his merry run of form on his return to county cricket.

items.title: 'We are only here to serve the cricketers': Tamim pushes back against BPL criticism
items.summary: Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) president Tamim Iqbal has defended his decision to postpone this season's Bangladesh Premier League (BPL), pushing back against critics by asserting that only a "partial story" of the controversy has been told.

items.title: BCB introduces major match-fee hikes amid BPL postponement
items.summary: Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) president Tamim Iqbal on Thursday announced major increases in match fees for domestic cricketers, amid growing concerns that top players could lose significant earnings following the postponement of this season’s Bangladesh Premier League (BPL).
